fact: The Botswana Police Service's own page, as captured on 4 June 2026, lists five policing divisions with 18, 12, 16, 13 and 21 police stations (80 in all) and 90, 90, 79, 35 and 124 police posts (418 in all), and places crime recording and analysis with the Operations Branch at headquarters in Gaborone; it gives the total only and says nothing of how many stations use a digital system.
title: Functional Areas
